==About==
The ''"'''[[Quake-o-Holics]] LAN'''"'', commonly known as '''"QHLAN"''', has for long been an institution in the QuakeWorld scene, considered to be the biggest and baddest QW event, it has been the pinnacle of prestige throughout the years. First spawned in "Galaxen", a community youth center in Rotebro Centrum, the location of the venue has shifted per edition. Up until 2019, various schools around Stockholm was the stage of the event.

QHLAN was was run annually between the years of [[2000]] and [[2011]] by [http://www.sla-sweden.org Stockholm LAN Association] (SLA) with {{player|Lornelin|flag=se}} in charge. 
{{#ev:youtube|5UCqNIx--U8|370|right|Swedish TV interview with {{player|Lornelin|flag=se}} from [[QHLAN3]], January 2002}}

After a six years hiatus QHLAN made a comeback in [[2017]], as a joint effort with [https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCSpQYalWI7qsi8nxMb-b2ww/videos?app=desktop&view=0&sort=p&flow=grid Hazard LAN], in Fredrika Bremergymnsiet - a school in Haninge south off Stockholm. Newfound partner {{player|Jehar|flag=us}} and the production of [http://twitch.tv/TastySpleenTV TastyspleenTV] flew in from Dallas to cast the event in situ. Attracting international top names such as {{player|GT|flag=br}} and {{player|BuLaT|flag=ru}}, the event was a huge success sparking new interest and energy into the scene. 

QHLAN made its only international appearance in Denmark in the summer of 2019, hosted by {{player|Zalon|flag=dk}} in a scout center in Silkeborg.

With [[QHLAN2022]], and later [[QHLAN2024]], {{player|bps|flag=se}} took over leadship and partnered up with old school legend {{player|Sniket|flag=se}} to host the two events in Epic Studios (his dance studio) in central Stockholm. 

[http://twitch.tv/TastySpleenTV TastyspleenTV] covered every QHLAN since 2017 from on site. Thanks to their immaculate production quality, QHLAN shaped into a professional show, broadcasting the best of QW to the world.
